title: bug: Setting auto configure needs to be pressed twice if Camera permission was not already enabled
body:
### Setting auto configure needs to be pressed twice if Camera permission was not already enabled

### Your environment
- xDrip master
- Android 10

### Expected behavior
From any place in xDrip where `AndroidBarcode.scan()` is called without Camera permission allowed, it should open the scanner after I allow Camera.

### Actual behavior
If Camera is not allowed and `AndroidBarcode.scan()` is called, I have to repeate the action after I allow Camera permission.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
* remove Camera permission from xDrip
* open Settings and select `Auto configure`
* you will be asked to allow Camera permission
* enable Camera permission
* nothing more will happen, you will still be in Settings
* click again on `Auto configure`
* scanner will start

### Other

Partially I added handling of this problem in my [pull request](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/1679/files#diff-7b618eef9ca42bc5ff63192f4928b6ee56d33b5699e16e883813120e8b1daff1R3676-R3677). It handles it in main activity. Not sure if this is the best fix. 
It needs to be handled also in `Preferences.java`. I tried to fix it, but `onRequestPermissionsResult()` was not fired, so I am creating this ticket.
